title: 第3章 新手大礼包第4章 父子相见
slug: 穿成皇子六连抽建立万古帝朝
lines: 看着自己的面板，萧风也是在琢磨，怎么才能快速变强，要不要直接把抽奖点直接抽掉，让自己快速地成长起来。
就在萧风纠结的时候，脑中突然传来了唯我主宰系统的声音：
【叮咚，发布终极任务：宿主需要完成一统乾坤大陆霸业，成为这片大陆的主宰！】
【奖励：九州镇魔鼎以及其他未知奖励。】
当萧风看到这个任务的时候，呆愣在原地，还没来得及反应，系统的任务发布的声音又响起来了：
【叮咚，发布主线任：出宫开府，并调查这次刺杀之人，只需找到是哪方势力即可。】
【奖励：抽奖点500，白银五十万两】
萧风看着这个新出的任务，想着，这系统也是真的够可以的，上来就是一顿画饼，不过还是要先达成眼下的任务吧。
“系统，你这激活了没有新手大礼包啥的吗？”
“主人，有的，需要现在发放吗？”软糯糯的声音响起。
萧风说道“发放，还有刚刚系统发布的声音为什么那么冰冷，而你的声音为什么这么软糯糯的？真的好听”
“主人，系统任务的发放是由系统设定的，而我是系统智灵，当然不一样了，请主人去储物空间，领取新人大礼包，另外得到主人初次夸奖，我可以额外赠送您一次抽奖机会，不消耗抽奖点的帝王抽奖次数。”
“我太爱你了，系统你有名字吗？”
“主人，我没有名字的。”
“那我以后叫你灵儿吧，你也不要叫我主人了，你叫我少爷就好。”
“好的，少爷，灵儿知道了，少爷给我取了名字，那我就额外再赠送您十万两白银，作为您的启动资金。”
“真的是谢谢灵儿了，我先去领礼包了。”
萧风迫不及待地去系统仓库，看到了躺在仓库中的新手大礼包，直接点击打开，
【叮，新手大礼包打开完毕！】
【获得功法：太初混沌诀（圣阶）】
【获得丹药：洗髓丹5枚（净化身体杂质，提升根骨和悟性）】
【获得抽奖次数：5次，不限奖池】
【获得兵器：青霜剑（天阶）】
content_en:
Looking at his own dashboard, Xiao Feng was also wondering how he could become stronger quickly. Should he just take away the lottery points and let himself grow up quickly?
Just when Xiao Feng was entangled, the voice of the only-self-dominated system suddenly came from his mind:
[Ding dong, the ultimate mission is released: the host needs to complete the hegemony of unifying the universe and become the master of this continent! 】
[Reward: Jiuzhou Demon Suppressing Cauldron and other unknown rewards. 】
When Xiao Feng saw this task, he froze in place. Before he could react, the system's task release sound sounded again:
[Ding dong, release the main mission: leave the palace, open a mansion, and investigate the person who assassinated this time. All you need to do is find out which force it is. 】
[Reward: 500 lottery points, 500,000 taels of silver]
Xiao Feng looked at this new mission and thought, this system is really good enough. It will be a feast for the eyes, but he still has to complete the current mission first.
"System, don't you have a novice gift package or something after activating it?"
"Master, there are some. Do you need to distribute them now?" A soft and waxy voice sounded.
Xiao Feng said, "Distribution, and why the sound released by the system just now is so cold, and why is your voice so soft and waxy? It really sounds nice."
"Master, the issuance of system tasks is set by the system, and I am the system intelligence. Of course it is different. Please go to the storage space and receive a gift package for newbies. In addition, after receiving the master's first compliment, I can give you an additional lottery opportunity. The number of emperor draws will not be consumed by the lottery points."
"I love you so much. System, do you have a name?"
"Master, I don't have a name."
"Then I'll call you Ling'er from now on. Don't call me master anymore. Just call me young master."
"Okay, Master, Ling'er knows. Master has given me a name, so I will give you an additional one hundred thousand taels of silver as your starting capital."
"Thank you very much, Ling'er. I'll go get the gift bag first."
Xiao Feng couldn't wait to go to the system warehouse and saw the novice gift package lying in the warehouse. He clicked to open it directly.
[Ding, the newbie gift package has been opened! 】
[Acquire the skill: Taichu Chaos Jue (Holy Level)]
[Obtain pills: 5 marrow-cleansing pills (purify body impurities, improve bones and understanding)]
[Number of lottery draws: 5 times, no limit on prize pool]
[Acquired weapon: Qingshuang Sword (Heavenly Level)]
title_en: Chapter 3 Newbie Gift Pack Chapter 4 Father and Son Meet
